title: Accounts
description: Issue registration links and move accounts through their lifecycle.

lifecycle.fastTrackHint: Approve without the onboarding meeting step.
lifecycle.noneAvailable: This account has no lifecycle actions left.

confirm.reasonHint: Between {{min}} and {{max}} characters. It is recorded in the audit log.

reject.title: Reject this account?
reject.body: The applicant is told the account was rejected and the email address is released for reuse. A rejected account can be reopened later.

suspend.title: Suspend this account?
suspend.body: The holder keeps the account but loses access until it is reactivated.

deactivate.title: Deactivate this account permanently?
deactivate.body: Access ends and the email address is released for reuse. This cannot be undone.

roles.label: Roles
roles.hint: Saving replaces the complete role set of this account.

refusal.admin_exclusive: The Administrator role cannot be combined with another role.

link.title: Registration links
link.description: Issue a link for someone to register with. The role is fixed by the link.
link.onceNotice: This is the only time the token is shown. Copy it now — it cannot be retrieved afterwards, and leaving this screen discards it.
link.noToken: The server returned no token for this link. Create another one.

pendingSkills.title: Pending skill terms
pendingSkills.description: Terms entered by candidates and seniors that the skill taxonomy could not match.
pendingSkills.empty: No skill terms are awaiting review.

pagination.pageSize: Showing up to {{size}} accounts per page.

announce.failed: The account list could not be loaded.
